entries.title: Amos 7:1
segments: ¶Thus did the Lord Jehovah shew unto me; and behold, he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth, and behold, it was the latter growth after the king's mowings.

entries.title: Amos 7:2
segments: And it came to pass, when they had wholly eaten the grass of the land, that I said, O Lord Jehovah, forgive, I beseech thee! How shall Jacob arise? for he is small.

entries.title: Amos 7:3
segments: Jehovah repented for this: It shall not be, said Jehovah.

entries.title: Amos 7:4
segments: Thus did the Lord Jehovah shew unto me; and behold, the Lord Jehovah called to contend by fire; and it devoured the great deep, and ate up the inheritance.

entries.title: Amos 7:5
segments: Then said I, O Lord Jehovah, cease, I beseech thee! How shall Jacob arise? for he is small.

entries.title: Amos 7:6
segments: Jehovah repented for this: This also shall not be, said the Lord Jehovah.

entries.title: Amos 7:7
segments: Thus did he shew unto me; and behold, the Lord stood upon a wall [made] by a plumb-line, with a plumb-line in his hand.

entries.title: Amos 7:8
segments: And Jehovah said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumb-line. And the Lord said, Behold, I will set a plumb-line in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more.

entries.title: Amos 7:9
segments: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolated, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will arise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.

entries.title: Amos 7:10
segments: ¶Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.

entries.title: Amos 7:11
segments: For thus Amos saith: Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall certainly go into captivity out of his land.

entries.title: Amos 7:12
segments: And Amaziah said unto Amos, [Thou] seer, go, flee away into the land of Judah, and eat bread there, and prophesy there.

entries.title: Amos 7:13
segments: But prophesy not again any more at Bethel; for it is the king's sanctuary, and it is the house of the kingdom.

entries.title: Amos 7:14
segments: And Amos answered and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was a herdman, and a gatherer of sycamore fruit.

entries.title: Amos 7:15
segments: And Jehovah took me as I followed the flock, and Jehovah said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.

entries.title: Amos 7:16
segments: And now hear thou the word of Jehovah: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and utter not [words] against the house of Isaac.

entries.title: Amos 7:17
segments: Therefore thus saith Jehovah: Thy wife shall be a harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided with the line; and thou shalt die in a land that is unclean; and Israel shall certainly go into captivity, out of his land.
